clips.notes: cheeky lad at rest: thumbs hooked in his sash, weight dropping onto one hip then the other, a little bounce up on his toes, glances round with a tilt of the head, quick blinks; arms stay low (fine with the robe on)
young and easy: 112 steps/min, springy bounce, free arm swings with loose hands, hips and chest counter-turn, head steady; arms stay low (the robe shows in S11 / S14), robe panels swing with the legs
chatty and cheeky: right palm-up offers on the stressed syllables, left thumb jabs at his own chest, head bobs and tilts, a shoulder shrug; jaw in an irregular syllable rhythm (lip sync overrides it)

S01 'just liked to play': leaning way back on nothing, hips pushed forward, both hands behind his head with the elbows out, right foot crossed in front tapping the toe; a big lazy yawn (head back, mouth wide, eyes shut, arms stretch) once per loop, then a smug look at the viewer; slow blinks

'Dad, give me my share - now!': a cocky stroll of half a step toward his father, right fist on his hip, the left hand comes out palm up (the purse lands in it at 22.18 s, timeline prop) with a little 'come on' finger wiggle, chin up, head tilted, cheeky grin, weight on one leg; holds the palm out

'Bye, Dad!': half turns away toward the road as if already leaving, and flings a big wave back over his right shoulder (three wrist-led waves, arm high), purse swinging in the left hand, grinning; turns back to face front and drops the arm, ready to strut

swagger: chest out, chin up, big rolling shoulders and hips, a springy bounce on every step, the right arm swinging wide with a floppy wrist, the purse swinging high in the left hand (spring-hung), head bobbing to an inner tune; 120 steps/min

'It's on me!': holds the purse up in his left hand, the right hand dips in for a fistful, winds down and flings the coins high (open hand up and out at 0.6 s = marker toss: the coins_spray FX starts there), watches them fly with a laugh, then ends showing off: purse held up, right fist on his hip, chest out (a steady pose to hold through the party lines)

silly party dance at the 'party' tempo (~134 bpm, a beat every 13.5 frames): knees bounce on every beat, hips wiggle, arms wave overhead in turn (right hand open, left hand waving the purse), head bobbing, a goofy step to each side, laughing

'Huh? Where's my money?': lifts the purse to his eye and peers in, shakes it by his ear (nothing), turns it upside down over his cupped right palm and shakes hard (nothing falls), lets it drop at 2.6 s (marker drop = the timeline's prop hide), then pulls his empty tunic 'pockets' out at both hips, looks down at his empty hands and freezes in a slumped, palms-up shrug (holds)

broke and alone: shoulders slumped, head hanging, arms dangling; slow heavy breaths with one long sigh (shoulders rise and drop), scuffs a toe in the dirt, one hopeless look up and round; slow heavy blinks
trudging to the pigs: slow (90 steps/min), head down, shoulders rounded, arms hanging and barely swinging, feet dragging (low lift), a heavy dip on every step

pig-boy: a mimed sack at his left hip (left forearm round it, fingers cupped), the right hand dips in and flings pods out to his left-front where the pigs are, twice per loop; bent a little, glum, head down toward the pigs, one weary wipe of the brow

'Even the pigs' pods look yummy...': leans toward the trough staring, hand rubbing his tummy in circles, licks his lips (jaw chews, head bobs), a greedy swallow, wipes his mouth with the back of the right hand; his tummy rumbles (a hunching jolt), sad droopy blinks; leans in and pulls back

homesick: sitting on the ground in the mud (hip joint 0.034 up), knees up, elbows on his knees and his face in his hands; slow sobbing breaths with little shudders, lifts his face once to stare at nothing and sinks back, a small head shake

'That's it! I'll go home!': from sitting (frame 0 = the sit_sad pose) his head pops up, eyes wide, the right hand shoots up with a straight 'finger' by his face, then he springs to his feet with a little hop and ends standing tall, both fists clenched at his chest, chin up, determined (holds)

trudging home rehearsing his speech, two slow pensive steps per 2 s (60 steps/min, short strides) while trying gestures: hand on heart, a deep humble bow, a cringing head-shake with a hand wave ('no, not like that'), then trying again with both palms open; lips moving; locomotion at a very slow walk

the last stretch home, worn out: slow (82 steps/min) heavy steps that barely clear the ground, a slight limp (the left step lands harder), body bent forward, arms limp, head low but lifting toward home

in his father's arms (father 0.10 in front): leans in, arms round the father's waist / back under the father's arms, cheek against the father's chest (head turned to his right), shoulders shaking with small sobs, rocking gently with the father (same 3 s rock: both sway to the same side of the stage)

'Dad, I was wrong...': still close to his father, he lets go and steps back into himself: hands clasped low in front, shoulders rounded, head bowed, a small sniff; holds (the father is still hugging him)

the best robe and the ring: looks down at himself and lifts the robe's front edges a little (wondering), brings the right hand up in front of his face to stare at the ring (eyebrows up, jaw drops), then spreads both hands, palms up, toward his father, amazed and grateful (holds); upper arms stay below 60 deg from hanging (the rigid robe)

joy at the feast (~108 bpm, a beat every 16.5 frames): bouncing side-steps, a quarter turn to each side so the robe swirls (robe panels swing out late), hands clapping and flicking out at chest height (upper arms below 60 deg: the rigid robe), head bobbing, laughing

S14 goodbye to the viewer: a big happy wave with the right hand up by his head (forearm up, elbow out forward-side so the upper arm stays under 60 deg in the rigid robe), wrist-led, three waves per loop, left hand on his chest, little bounce, head tilt, smile

a warm old man at rest: hands folded over his belly, slow deep breaths (the stoop lifts a little on the inhale), weight shifts, a slow look round and a kind nod, once strokes his beard with the right hand; slow blinks; beard, head-cloth and robe panels sway late
dignified: unhurried 90 steps/min, a little stooped, hands clasped behind his back, firm heel strikes, gentle hip sway; the open robe's panels swing with the legs, beard and head-cloth follow late

warm and plain: the right hand opens palm-up toward the listener on the stressed syllables, the left comes to his heart once, slow nods on the beats, small head tilts; jaw in an irregular syllable rhythm (lip sync overrides it); beard follows the jaw

giving away half of everything: the right hand is inside his robe at the chest (purse shown from 0, half hidden), slowly draws the purse out and looks at it, holds it out to his son at chest height with a small hesitation (pulls back, then offers), lets go at 2.2 s (marker give: the timeline swaps the purse to the son), then lays the empty hand on his heart and bows his head (holds)

watching his son go: a slow wave with the right hand at shoulder height (two slow side-to-side sweeps), the hand sinks and hangs, a sad sigh with the head dropping, then he lifts it to wave again; the left hand rests on his heart

every day at the gate: right hand shading his eyes (palm down over the brows), leaning forward from the hips, rising onto his toes to see further, head slowly scanning the road left-right-centre, the left hand on the small of his back (old back); a hopeful little lean, then a sigh back down

'Is that... my boy?!': freezes mid-breath, both hands fly to his mouth (gasp), leans in staring, a trembling half second, then the arms swing wide open, palms forward, chest lifting, laughing through tears (holds, ready to run)

THE moment: an old man's joyful, slightly clumsy run (150 steps/min, short strides, a little float): the left fist hitches the robe's left front panel up at his hip, the right arm reaches forward toward his son, wobbling; body pitched forward, a lopsided bob (the right step lands heavier), shoulders rolling, head-cloth and beard flying back, the free right panel flapping

the son found (son 0.10 in front): leaning over him, both arms wrapped round his shoulders and upper back, his cheek on the top of his son's head (head turned to his right), eyes shut, rocking gently from side to side, the right hand patting the son's back now and then; a happy shaky sob in the breath; robe panels and beard sway with the rock

'Quick! Bring the best robe!': straightens up as far as his old back allows, claps twice above his head, flings the right arm out pointing to his right (toward the house), then brings both hands together at his chest, beaming (a happy pose to hold while the servants answer)
'Let's celebrate!': a little bounce and both arms fly up in a wide V, head thrown back laughing (jaw pulses), chest lifted; holds arms up, beaming

an old man's happy folk dance at the feast (~108 bpm, beat every 16.5 frames): claps on 2 and 4 with the hands at chin height, a step-together side-step that bounces on every beat, shoulders shimmying, a little turn to each side, head bobbing, beard and robe swinging, laughing

begging his angry son to come in: leaning in, both palms open and up toward him, gently pumping on the stressed words, head tilted, a slow nod; the left hand once comes to his heart; jaw talks softly (lip sync overrides it)

'Come, my son': slowly holds out his right hand at chest height toward the elder son 0.10-0.12 in front (wrist 0.062 in front, palm half up, fingers open), the left hand on his heart, head tilted, a warm smile; holds still so the brother can take the hand (take_hand meets it)

the hard-working elder son at rest: the hoe planted at his right side with his fist on top, the left fist on his hip, broad stance, weight shifts, a slow look over the field, wipes his brow with the back of the left wrist once, a stretch of the back; steady blinks

coming home from the field: the hoe on his right shoulder (fist in front at the chest, blade behind his back), heavy purposeful 100 steps/min, the left arm swinging, shoulders rolling, head-cloth tails bouncing late

blunt and firm: leaning a little on the planted hoe, the left hand chops the air on the stressed syllables and once taps his chest, head nods hard on the beats; jaw in an irregular rhythm (lip sync overrides it)

hoeing: bent over the bare strip, the right fist at the top of the handle and the left hand lower down it; the blade chops into the soil in front (blade edge on the page at the strike, marker strike) and drags back toward him, then he straightens a little and swings the hoe up and forward for the next chop; knees soft, the body rocks with the stroke, a grunt in the jaw at the strike
watching his little brother swagger off: leans both hands on the planted hoe in front, a long disapproving look, three slow head shakes with a tut (jaw), lips pressed; holds leaning on the hoe

stops dead at the courtyard wall: swings the hoe down off his shoulder and plants it, cups his left hand behind his left ear, head tilted and turned toward the house (music and dancing?!), frowning; holds listening

'Hmph!': two big angry stamps (left, right: knee up high, a jolt through the body), then the arms cross high on his chest with the hoe held upright in the crook of the arms, chin up, head turned away (holds the stubborn pose)

'All these years I worked for you...': jabs his left finger at his father, then thumps his own chest ('I!'), then throws both hands up in disgust (the hoe goes up too), head shaking; jaw talks angrily (lip sync overrides it)

his father's words land: a long breath out, the arms uncross and drop, shoulders sink, the hoe hangs loose in his right hand (blade near the ground), the head lowers to look at his feet, a small swallow, hurt and thinking (holds)

the open ending: a still pause looking down, a breath, he lifts his eyes to his father, then slowly reaches his left hand out and takes the father's offered right hand at chest height (wrist 0.046 in front: meets arm_out at 0.10-0.12 apart), a small squeeze; holds hand in hand, hoe hanging in the right

stage.sitSadNote: son sit_sad / idea_stand frame 0: sitting on the page, knees up (no seat needed)
stage.hugNote: father hug + son hug: actors 0.10 apart facing each other; the rock is the same 3 s sine, both sway to the same side of the stage
stage.takeHandNote: brother take_hand meets father arm_out when they stand 0.10-0.12 apart

propWindows.son_ask_money: purse shown only in the held end pose (it lands there at 22.18 s)
